set.body: Add an immutable effect_space with ordered coordinates, basis_id, units/scaling, provenance, and stable signature. Bind relations, extractors, queries, plan IDs, and results to it. Align fully named precomputed rows to the declared order; reject missing, extra, duplicated, partially named, incompatible-basis, or incompatible-unit coordinates before source access. Preserve raw-effect and reparameterization laws.
set.title: Implement effect-space identity and strict partition alignment
